title: Adapting the Actor Model of Concurrency for High-Frequency Trading: Synchronous Message Delivery (fast_send) and a Tick-to-Book Latency Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.21173v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The actor model - state isolation, data-race freedom, deadlock resistance, and sequential single-message reasoning - has long been dismissed as unsuitable for high-frequency trading (HFT): actors seem to imply many threads, a mailbox per actor, and a heap-allocated message plus a context switch per interaction, overhead incompatible with a microsecond budget. This paper argues the dismissal is wrong for co-located actors, and supports it both analytically and with a deployed, measured implementation: kaspar-hft, an open-source C++20 framework. Four extensions adapt the model for HFT: fast_send, a synchronous delivery mechanism in which the sending thread runs the receiver's handler inline and returns the reply as a value; actor groups, which co-schedule actors on one thread behind a shared mailbox; per-actor selectable mailbox queues; and a memory pool. fast_send has receiver transparency: the handler cannot tell whether delivery was syn

translated_title: 将并发的Actor模型适配于高频交易：同步消息传递机制（fast_send）与Tick-to-Book延迟研究
translated_abstract: Actor模型——具备状态隔离、无数据竞争、抗死锁以及顺序单消息推理等特性——长期以来被认为不适合高频交易（HFT）：actor似乎意味着大量线程、每个actor一个邮箱，以及每次交互都需要堆分配消息加上下文切换，这种开销与微秒级的时延预算不相容。本文论证这种否定对于同置部署的actor而言是错误的，并通过理论分析以及一个已部署、经过实测的实现来支持这一论点：kaspar-hft，一个开源的C++20框架。本文提出四项扩展将该模型适配于HFT：fast_send，一种同步消息传递机制，发送线程内联执行接收者的消息处理函数并以值的形式返回回复；actor组，通过共享邮箱将多个actor协同调度至同一线程；每个actor可选的邮箱队列；以及内存池。fast_send具有接收者透明性：消息处理函数无法分辨消息传递是同步的还是（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文通过对Actor模型进行四项扩展（核心是发送线程内联执行接收者处理函数并同步返回回复的fast_send机制），论证并实测验证了Actor模型经适配后可满足高频交易的微秒级延迟要求，并开源了C++20框架kaspar-hft。
en_tdlr: This paper adapts the actor model for high-frequency trading through four extensions—most notably fast_send, a synchronous delivery mechanism where the sender thread runs the receiver's handler inline and returns the reply as a value—and validates microsecond-scale feasibility with a deployed, open-source C++20 framework, kaspar-hft.
